en.name: HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle (RAL 8000)
en.description: The HK416 A5 is a further development of the HK416 assault rifle in 5.56x45mm NATO caliber. The most striking changes compared to its previous versions as well as to market available AR platforms include an improved and tool-less gas regulator for suppressor use, a redesigned, user-friendly lower receiver, which allows complete ambidextrous operation of the weapon and ensures optimised magazine compatibility. Additionally, numerous technical improvements to maximize the safety of the operator, weapon reliability, ammunition compatibility, and durability under real operating conditions. RAL 8000 color version.

en.name: Howa Type 20 5.56x45 assault rifle
en.description: A Japanese 5.56x45 assault rifle developed by Howa Machinery as the successor to the Type 89. Designed to meet modern battlefield requirements, it features improved ergonomics, ambidextrous controls, and enhanced reliability in harsh environments. Currently in service with the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force.

en.name: Norinco QBZ-191 5.8x42 assault rifle
en.description: A Chinese 5.8x42 assault rifle developed by Norinco as the successor to the QBZ-95. Featuring a conventional layout, fully ambidextrous controls, and a full-length optics rail, it was designed to improve ergonomics, modularity, and overall combat effectiveness.
